Drillers and blasters die in blasts, so each later pattern re-hires and re-equips a crew and rig. #1649: charging is worked from a charging truck by a blasting + driving.truck employee. Each blast destroys the truck, so patterns 2-4 each buy a fresh charging truck; no licence step is needed because a hired Blaster arrives with blasting + driving.truck level 1 (#1667), so the former per-pattern `employee assign_skill ... driving.truck` bootstrap steps are gone; death counts and ecology/nuisance figures were re-measured, and the closing profit reads 250000 (#1660 shifted charging timing by a few ticks, so a random employee_joins event now lands earlier and the figures here were re-measured; the old 250000 float residue is gone). Survey, tick, death (1, 2, 3, 5 after #1773) and score pins re-measured in command mode; the run still completes as a win with no refused command.
